title: Leakage- and Label-Aware Benchmarking of Class-Imbalance Strategies for Multimodal Chest X-Ray and EHR Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.07950v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmarks of class-imbalance strategies for multimodal chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) prediction are often evaluated on record-level splits of cohorts in which one patient contributes several radiographs. We audit such a benchmark on 29,083 MIMIC-CXR radiographs of 10,479 patients with eight diagnosis targets. First, the record-split benchmark was misleading: a lookup table that copies the label of a development-set radiograph with the same EHR vector nearly matched the best model, and on unseen patients every model fell to the level of predicting every case positive. Second, tracing the labels back to MIMIC-IV explained why: each patient's labels are keyword matches on the diagnosis codes of a single admission, copied, with one EHR vector per patient, to all of the patient's radiographs, so about a third of the radiographs carry labels that differ from the codes of their own admission. translated_title: 面向多模态胸片与电子健康记录分类的类别不平衡策略的泄漏与标签感知基准测试
translated_abstract: 针对多模态胸片（CXR）与电子健康记录（EHR）预测的类别不平衡策略基准，通常在记录级划分的数据队列上进行评估，其中一名患者会贡献多张放射影像。我们在涵盖八个诊断目标、包含10,479名患者的29,083张MIMIC-CXR影像的基准上进行了审计。首先，记录级划分的基准具有误导性：一个仅复制开发集中具有相同EHR向量的影像标签的查找表，其表现几乎与最佳模型相当；而在未见过的患者上，所有模型的表现都退化到将每个病例都预测为阳性的水平。其次，将标签追溯至MIMIC-IV解释了原因：每位患者的标签是基于单次住院诊断代码的关键词匹配结果，并连同每位患者的一个EHR向量一起被复制到该患者的所有影像上，因此约三分之一的影像所携带的标签与其自身住院记录的诊断代码不符。第三，在患者分离划分下……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究对多模态胸片与EHR类别不平衡基准进行审计，揭示了记录级数据划分导致的标签泄漏问题——患者标签由单次住院的诊断代码生成并复制到其所有影像，造成基准性能虚高，因此需要采用患者级数据划分与标签感知的评估方式。
en_tdlr: Auditing a multimodal chest X-ray and EHR class-imbalance benchmark reveals severe label leakage from record-level splits—patient labels are keyword-matched from a single admission's codes and copied to all of that patient's radiographs—inflating benchmark results and motivating patient-separated, label-aware evaluation.
